title: Why Your Stamp Keeps Getting More Expensive
hook: Americans mail far less than before, yet a stamp costs more than ever.
closing: Fewer letters are moving through the system, so the ones left behind pay more to cover it.
question: What do you still mail?

segments.say: Total US mail volume fell to 109 billion pieces, nearly half its old peak.
First-Class letter mail fell even further, to 46 billion pieces from its own peak.
A stamp now costs 68 cents, more than double what it cost back in 1995.
